entityRemapIntro: Named-entity recognition sometimes returns the wrong Wikidata entity — typically the party where the speech means the parliamentary group, or a regional branch where the platform tracks the national entity. Each row below rewrites one source ID to the ID the platform actually holds, before the annotation is stored. Existing annotations are not changed; a new mapping takes effect on the next import of the affected speeches.
entityRemapConfirmDelete: Delete this mapping? Imports will keep the source ID unchanged from then on.

conflictConfirmDelete: Delete this conflict? This cannot be undone.
conflictConfirmBulkDelete: Delete {count} conflicts? This cannot be undone.
conflictTypePersonMissingWikidataIdExpla: This speaker could not be matched to an entity in the platform database, so the speech was imported without a speaker link. Add the person as an entity and re-run the pipeline for the affected sessions — the conflict clears automatically when the corrected data is re-imported.
conflictTypeFactionMissingWikidataIdExpl: This faction or group could not be matched to an entity in the platform database, so it was not linked. Add the organisation as an entity and re-run the pipeline for the affected sessions — the conflict clears automatically when the corrected data is re-imported.
conflictTypePersonMissingContextExplanat: A person was linked to a speech without a role (speaker, mentioned, …); the role was set to "unknown".
conflictTypeMediaImportErrorExplanation: A database error occurred while saving a speech. Points to a bug or a data integrity issue — check the error details.
conflictTypeMediaValidationErrorExplanat: A speech could not be imported because required fields were missing in the source data. The speech was skipped entirely.
conflictTypeAnnotationImportErrorExplana: A database error occurred while saving an automatically detected entity annotation.
conflictTypeTextImportErrorExplanation: A database error occurred while saving a speech transcript.
conflictTypeDocumentMissingSourceUriExpl: A referenced document has no source URL and could not be linked to the speech.
conflictTypeEntitySuggestionMissingIdExp: An automatically detected entity could not be added to the suggestions because it has no Wikidata ID.
conflictTypeLegacyUnclassifiedExplanatio: Conflict migrated from the previous system that could not be assigned to a known type.
bulkIgnoreByType: Ignore all open conflicts of this type
bulkDeleteByType: Delete all conflicts of this type

statisticsClaim: How parliament speaks: speeches, speaking time and vocabulary over time.
statisticsSpeakingTimeNote: Total duration of the speech items, including applause and interruptions.
statisticsWordsNote: Counts cover what the speaker said. Interjections and procedural remarks by the chair are not included.
statisticsNoWordsSelected: Add a word to see how often it is used over time.
statisticsNoTrendData: No occurrences found for these words.
statisticsRelativeNote: Relative to everything spoken in the same month, so a busy month does not look like a trend.
statisticsFirstUseNote: First use recorded on this platform, not necessarily the first time it was said in parliament.
statisticsDistinctiveWordsNote: Words that stand out here compared with the rest of the corpus — not simply the most frequent ones.
statisticsNoEntitySelected: Choose an entity to see where it appears.
statisticsMentionsNote: Speeches that mention this entity. A person’s own speeches are not counted as mentions.
